tasks.request: Fix merge_ranges. It must accept integer endpoint pairs, normalize reversed endpoints, return a new sorted list of tuples, merge overlapping or adjacent integer ranges, return an empty list for empty input, and never mutate the input. Change only ranges.py.

Fix redact_query. Preserve URL scheme, authority, path, query-pair order, fragments, repeated keys, and blank non-sensitive values. Replace values for token, password, and api_key keys case-insensitively with [REDACTED], including percent-encoded keys. Change only redaction.py and use the Python standard library.

Fix retry_delays. max_attempts includes the initial attempt, so return max_attempts - 1 delays. Require max_attempts >= 1, initial_delay > 0, multiplier >= 1, and a positive max_delay when supplied. Apply the optional cap to every returned delay and do not mutate inputs. Change only retry.py.
